episodes.title: Brothers in Arms
episodes.summary: Winston Scott gets roped into a vast conspiracy triggered by his brother's raid on the Continental.

episodes.title: Loyalty to the Master
episodes.summary: Knowing he can't attack Cormac alone, Winston recruits a crew to overthrow the Continental.

episodes.title: Theater of Pain
episodes.summary: Despite dissent and distrust, Winston's team wages an ingenious all-out assault on the hotel.
